description: In 1970s Colombia, mysterious Eva Samper becomes the first girl at an all-boys school and unsettles its routines, assumptions and friendships. Camilo falls for her as their classmates confront changing ideas about literature, relationships, family, politics and growing up. Season 1 in this collection runs from "Lysistrata" through "The Catcher in the Rye", preserving the collection-local episode order and source runtimes.

s01e01.description: Upon Eva's arrival, her classmates — particularly Camilo — take to her "teachings" and musings. But not everyone is warm and welcoming.

s01e02.description: Suspecting Eva is too good to be true, the guys investigate her, but it's they who end up exposed. The gang has a life-altering, first-time experience.

s01e03.description: Upon hearing Eva might leave the school, the guys huddle and devise a scheme to help her stay… ultimately setting the stage for an explosive scene.

s01e04.description: Eva makes a strong impression on Camilo's parents. The group's clandestine project gets Camilo and Eva suspended. Pabón receives devastating news.

s01e05.description: With Estela's word against Mr. Pabón's, Camilo and Eva must dig deeper to find out the truth — all amidst hefty accusations and arguments.

s01e06.description: Camilo's suspicions about Eva's story deepen. He offers to help her with her grades but she has other plans — which pierce a dagger in his heart.

s01e07.description: After a night of drinking, Eva lets intimate details of her life slip out, prompting Camilo to ask Arbeláez to keep a close eye on her.

s01e08.description: Protests in the streets cause tension amongst the group and in Camilo's home. Camilo proceeds with a Machiavellian plan to make Eva jealous.

s01e09.description: Camilo finds himself in a tricky position, but one where he can finally express his feelings. There's only one problem: the recipient of his affection.

s01e10.description: Eva comes to Camilo's rescue. Martín blames Eva for the group's constant feuding. A party seemingly gone awry opens a window of opportunity for Camilo.

s01e11.description: Camilo's dad's plan to take him to see a priest backfires. Martín opens up like never before. The gang must say goodbye to a dear friend.

s01e12.description: Eva and Camilo have a blast getting into mischief. Camilo shows just how far he'll go to protect Eva, finally finding the key to her heart.

s01e13.description: While his parents navigate their roughest patch, Camilo enjoys his sunniest days with Eva. But will their love survive the gloomy horizon?
